skipped.reason: File:Halal Beef Lasagne and Cauliflowers - Foodilic 2024-08-12.jpg: refused on review — A canteen tray where the lasagne is a brown lump beside yellow cauliflower. Accurately titled, unappetising, and unrecognisable as the dish.
File:Levantine Lentil Soup winter Newton Massachusetts New England.jpg: refused on review — A featureless pale disc filling the frame. Nothing in it reads as soup.

File:Menemen Emiralem Strawberry.jpg: refused on review — A punnet of strawberries. Third attempt for this recipe and the third non-food result: the dish shares its name with a Turkish district, so its Commons category is landscapes, trains and produce. It keeps the branded fallback.
